title.en: Resolution-robust Large Mask Inpainting with Fourier Convolutions

notes.en: Primary WACV 2022 record for the exact paper. It verifies the complete author list, publication venue and year, abstract, open-access PDF, and links to the arXiv version; the paper source verifies the author affiliations and correspondence note.
notes.zh: 与该论文精确匹配的 WACV 2022 主记录，用于核验完整作者列表、发表会议与年份、摘要、开放获取 PDF 和 arXiv 链接；论文源文件还核验了作者机构与通讯联系人说明。

title.zh: LaMa 的 OpenAlex 论文与作者记录

notes.en: Secondary bibliographic verification for the DOI, 2022 publication year, full authorship, Roman Suvorov's Samsung AI Center Moscow affiliation, and Victor Lempitsky's Samsung/Skoltech affiliations and ORCID.
notes.zh: 用于辅助核验 DOI、2022 年发表年份、完整作者列表、罗曼·苏沃洛夫的三星莫斯科 AI 中心机构，以及维克托·列姆皮茨基的三星/Skoltech 机构与 ORCID。

title.en: arXiv: Resolution-robust Large Mask Inpainting with Fourier Convolutions
title.zh: 《Resolution-robust Large Mask Inpainting with Fourier Convolutions》

notes.en: Author-posted full paper under CC BY 4.0. It verifies the three LaMa components, the complete author order, affiliations, correspondence note, submission history, and WACV 2022 status.
notes.zh: 作者提交并以 CC BY 4.0 发布的论文全文，用于核验 LaMa 的三个组成部分、完整作者顺序、机构、通讯联系人说明、提交历史和 WACV 2022 状态。

notes.en: The project page lists the complete author team, links the paper and code, explains the image-wide receptive field and resolution generalization, and does not provide personal portraits for the two BenchCouncil contributors.
notes.zh: 项目页列出完整作者团队，链接论文与代码，并解释全图感受野和分辨率泛化；该页没有提供两位 BenchCouncil 主要人物的个人肖像。

notes.en: Official implementation linked from the paper and project page; the repository is Apache-2.0 licensed. Its owner is the Image Manipulation organization, so the organization avatar was rejected as a portrait of Roman Suvorov.
notes.zh: 论文与项目页链接的官方实现，仓库采用 Apache-2.0 许可。仓库所有者是 Image Manipulation 组织，因此其组织头像不能作为罗曼·苏沃洛夫肖像。
